description: ADO-BATCH-SCOPE, the clone variant from the other side: the same clone edit of row 6, but UpdateBatch(adAffectAll) is called on the CLONE first, then the original's row 6 value, Recordset.Status and pending-filter count are read, the independent reader runs after 8 s, and the original's UpdateBatch follows with a second reader. Asks whether a clone's batch submits its own pending edit and what the original shows afterwards.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-ado-misc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
